Aisha (PM): Quick sync — AcmeHealth asked about a paid pilot: they want pricing + explicit feedback commitments before we move to a Dedicated slot. Need to finalize our offer and the success metrics by EOD tomorrow. Who can take point on the pricing proposal?
Elena (CRO): I can draft a revenue + credits hybrid. Proposal: 3 months, 50% credits up to $25k + minimum monthly revenue $5k. In exchange they commit 8 structured feedback sessions and share 3 canonical prompts+use-cases. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (Design): That commitment sounds reasonable. We should specify feedback cadence & artifacts: 6 product-run sessions (40–60m), 2 high-level executive check-ins, and a shared Figma + recordings repo. Also require them to capture 50 labeled examples for quality regressions.
Luca (Eng): From infra side, Dedicated slot for 3 months is doable if we gate concurrency. Need to know: expected peak qps and average sequence length. Otherwise we'll quote wrong. Marco, can you ask for a brief perf sample from them?
Marco (SE): On it. I sent a quick sampling script and instructions to Acme contact just now with this snippet:
```bash
# run against our sample harness
curl -sS -X POST https://redwood.example/ping -d '{"seq_len":256,"qps":10}'
```
I asked for three payload sizes (128/512/2k) and a representative batch of prompts.
Aisha (PM): Good. Also need launch criteria — here's my draft shortlist: 1) integration done + 1 full end-to-end demo, 2) latency P50 < 350ms and P99 < 1.2s for agreed workload, 3) no more than 3 severity-1 incidents in 30 days, 4) agreed feedback artifacts delivered. Any missing items?
Elena (CRO): Add churn-signal: they must pass a minimal ROI check (usage >= 10k tokens/month or 5% of team usage) to qualify for reduced credit.
Priya (Design): Add qualitative quality gate: customer rates outputs >= 4/5 on 3 prompt families in a blind eval. We can run that as part of their feedback sessions.
Luca (Eng): Two engineering ask items: 1) explicit rollback plan to hosted fallback, 2) brief runbook for their SRE on incident escalation. I can own both.
Aisha (PM): Perfect. For acceptance criteria doc I'll merge these points. Next: pricing negotiation approach — Elena, propose a short options matrix (credits-first, revenue-share, pilot-fee). We should also include an accelerated discount if they convert to Dedicated within 60 days.
Elena (CRO): Will do. Tentative matrix by tomorrow morning. Also looping in legal for a slim NDA + data handling clause.
dp-bot: POLL created: "Preferred pilot incentive" — options: "50% credits + min revenue", "Flat pilot fee", "Revenue-share (rev % of license)" — vote by 12pm.
Marco (SE): Timeline check: once perf samples are back (24–48h), Eng can estimate infra cost and we can finalize the matrix.
Aisha (PM): Action items: Elena drafts matrix + send to legal; Marco confirms perf sample results; Luca builds rollback/runbook; Priya drafts feedback artifact templates. I'll assemble acceptance doc and send to Acme.
Elena (CRO): One more ask from sales: if they want exclusive competitive protections, price will need to reflect that — flagging now.
Priya (Design): Noted. Also creating a simple 10-question feedback form we can use during sessions (will push to the shared drive).
Aisha (PM): Thanks team — aiming to send a clean proposal by EOD tomorrow. If anyone needs extra bandwidth ping me directly. :rocket:
